#install.packages("netUtils")

# Setup Networks

```{r}
set.seed(123)
n <- 1000
p <- 0.01

# Erdos-Renyi Graph
g_er <- sample_gnp(n, p, directed = FALSE)

# Barabasi-Albert Graph
g_ba <- sample_pa(
  n = n,
  m = 5,                    # Each new node attaches to 5 existing nodes
  directed = FALSE,
  algorithm = "psumtree"    # Efficient algorithm for large networks
)

# LFR Graph
g_lfr <- sample_lfr(
  n = 1000, 
  tau1 = 2,           # Power-law exponent for degree distribution
  tau2 = 1,           # Power-law exponent for community sizes
  mu = 0.1,           # Mixing parameter (low = clear communities)
  average_degree = 10, 
  max_degree = 50, 
  min_community = 20, 
  max_community = 60
)

```

## Plot Degree Distributions and Graphs

```{r}
set.seed(123)

# Use Fruchterman-Reingold layout for better visualization
layout_er <- layout_with_fr(g_er, niter = 500)
layout_ba <- layout_with_fr(g_ba, niter = 500)
layout_lfr <- layout_with_fr(g_lfr, niter = 500)

# Function to create consistent network plots
plot_network <- function(g, layout, title, highlight_hubs = TRUE) {
  deg <- degree(g)
  
  # Color nodes by degree (highlight hubs)
  if (highlight_hubs) {
    # Scale colors by degree quantile
    col_palette <- colorRampPalette(c("lightblue", "blue", "red"))(100)
    node_colors <- col_palette[cut(deg, breaks = 100, labels = FALSE)]
    node_colors[is.na(node_colors)] <- col_palette[1]
    
    # Size proportional to log-degree for visibility
    node_sizes <- 1 + 2 * (deg / max(deg))
  } else {
    node_colors <- "lightblue"
    node_sizes <- 2
  }
  
  plot(g,
       layout = layout,
       vertex.size = node_sizes,
       vertex.color = node_colors,
       vertex.frame.color = NA,
       vertex.label = NA,
       edge.color = rgb(0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 0.3),  # Transparent edges
       edge.width = 0.3,
       main = title)
}

# Create network plots
par(mfrow = c(1, 3), mar = c(2, 2, 3, 2))
plot_network(g_er, layout_er, "Erdős-Rényi (Random)")
plot_network(g_ba, layout_ba, "Barabási-Albert (Scale-Free)")
plot_network(g_lfr, layout_lfr, "LFR (Planted Communities)")

# Function to create degree distribution dataframe
get_degree_df <- function(g, name) {
  deg <- degree(g)
  data.frame(
    degree = as.numeric(names(table(deg))),
    count = as.numeric(table(deg)),
    frequency = as.numeric(table(deg)) / length(deg),
    network = name
  )
}

# Combine all degree distributions
df_deg <- rbind(
  get_degree_df(g_er, "Erdős-Rényi"),
  get_degree_df(g_ba, "Barabási-Albert"),
  get_degree_df(g_lfr, "LFR Benchmark")
)

# Linear scale plot
p1 <- ggplot(df_deg, aes(x = degree, y = frequency, color = network)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.5) +
  facet_wrap(~network, scales = "free") +
  labs(title = "Degree Distributions (Linear Scale)",
       x = "Degree (k)", y = "P(k)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))

# Log-log scale (reveals power-law in BA)
p2 <- ggplot(df_deg[df_deg$count > 0, ], 
             aes(x = degree, y = frequency, color = network)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_y_log10() +
  facet_wrap(~network, scales = "free") +
  labs(title = "Degree Distributions (Log-Log Scale)",
       subtitle = "Linear trend in BA confirms power-law P(k) ~ k^(-γ)",
       x = "Degree (k)", y = "P(k)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))

grid.arrange(p1, p2, nrow = 2)

plot_ba_hubs <- function(g, layout) {
  deg <- degree(g)
  hub_threshold <- quantile(deg, 0.95)  # Top 5% as hubs
  
  # Color:  red for hubs, light blue for others
  node_colors <- ifelse(deg >= hub_threshold, "red", "lightblue")
  
  # Size: larger for hubs
  node_sizes <- ifelse(deg >= hub_threshold, 4, 1)
  
  plot(g,
       layout = layout,
       vertex.size = node_sizes,
       vertex.color = node_colors,
       vertex.frame.color = NA,
       vertex.label = NA,
       edge.color = rgb(0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 0.2),
       edge.width = 0.2,
       main = "Barabási-Albert:  Hub Structure",
       sub = paste("Red nodes: top 5% by degree (k ≥", round(hub_threshold), ")"))
}

par(mfrow = c(1, 1), mar = c(4, 2, 3, 2))
plot_ba_hubs(g_ba, layout_ba)

# Summary Statistics
network_stats <- data.frame(
  Network = c("Erdős-Rényi", "Barabási-Albert", "LFR"),
  Nodes = c(vcount(g_er), vcount(g_ba), vcount(g_lfr)),
  Edges = c(ecount(g_er), ecount(g_ba), ecount(g_lfr)),
  Avg_Degree = round(c(mean(degree(g_er)), mean(degree(g_ba)), mean(degree(g_lfr))), 2),
  Max_Degree = c(max(degree(g_er)), max(degree(g_ba)), max(degree(g_lfr))),
  Clustering = round(c(transitivity(g_er), transitivity(g_ba), transitivity(g_lfr)), 4)
)

print(network_stats)
```

# Setup and Run Simulations

```{r}
perturbations <- list(del = edge_removal,
                      add = edge_addition,
                      rewire = edge_rewiring)
fractions <- c(0.01, 0.02, 0.03, 0.05)

cluster.algs <- list(louvain = cluster_louvain,
                     leiden = cluster_leiden,
                     infomap = cluster_infomap,
                     spectral = spectral_clustering_shi_malik,
                     girvan_newman = cluster_edge_betweenness)

stoc.algs <- list(louvain = TRUE,
                  leiden = TRUE,
                  infomap = TRUE,
                  spectral = TRUE,
                  girvan_newman = FALSE)
```

```{r}
results_er <- run_simulations(g_er, "ER", perturbations, fractions, cluster.algs, stoc.algs, iter.pert = 100, iter.stoc = 50)
results_ba <- run_simulations(g_ba, "BA", perturbations, fractions, cluster.algs, stoc.algs, iter.pert = 100, iter.stoc = 50)
results_lfr <- run_analysis(g_lfr, "LFR", perturbations, fractions, cluster.algs, stoc.algs, iter.pert = 100, iter.stoc = 50)
```
